title: form_draft.js: DOMContentLoaded boot path now passes the Event as `env` — saver silently never initialises on the non-defer fallback branch
detail: Round-2's env injection makes the DOMContentLoaded listener receive the Event as env; env.document is undefined so initBrowser returns silently at the !body guard. Round-1's no-arg version worked as a listener. Latent only because SSR always defers the script (readyState interactive); form_stepper.js's identical pattern still works.
recommended_fix: Wrap the listener: root.document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { initBrowser(); }); — or guard with env = env && env.document ? env : root.
